findings.title: phase.schema.json requires agent on every active phase, but d-system governance requires it only when max_active > 1; at max_active 1 the new whole-backlog check would fail a phase governance accepts.
findings.evidence: docs/00-working/framework/05-schemas/phase.schema.json:254-258 vs src/governance/backlog.py:136-139; max_active is 4 today and was 3 earlier; its schema minimum is 1.
findings.consequence: A false failure of the check this phase adds, the first time max_active is set to 1. Untested and undocumented.

findings.title: The portable schema allows one acceptance condition while schemas/backlog.schema.json requires two, and neither file cross-references the other.
findings.consequence: Drift risk between two overlapping schemas.
